scientific_integrity: The base recurrences are classical and are explicitly credited; the claimed new information is simultaneous all-modulus concentration and evaluated modulo-three population growth. Finite checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: General-modulus decay bound may be nonoptimal; exact ternary spectrum and exponent apply at fixed integer base. An inaccessible 2016 pointwise-evaluation paper and unindexed stronger aggregate identities remain historical-priority risks. No independent validation.
title: Profinite concentration and sharp ternary sparsity for hyper-ary partition counts
